blueprint.name: AWS EKS Cluster - Demo
blueprint.description: Streamlined AWS EKS cluster for fast demos — VPC + IAM + EKS only. Skips storage and high-performance nodes. Provide a project name, pick your AWS credentials + region, and click Deploy. Every other setting is pre-defaulted and adjustable later under Advanced.

outcomes: VPC with public + private subnets across two AZs
Jumphost EC2 with SSH key + Elastic IP
EKS cluster with m5.xlarge worker nodes
IAM roles + OIDC provider ready for service accounts

prerequisites.name: aws_credentials
prerequisites.description: AWS credential template (any of Forge's three auth methods). Principal needs VPC + EKS + IAM create privileges.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: Auto-filled from the AWS credential template.

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: Auto-filled from the AWS credential template.

required.name: aws_region
required.description: AWS region to deploy into (taken from the project).

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: Auto-filled from the AWS credential template (STS/SSO only).
